blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Morgan Creek fell from 48 in June to 45 in October (−6.2%), and 16 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 7.9% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 570 houses listed.

blocks.text: Morgan Creek Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Morgan Creek is a golf-course neighbourhood inside Rosemary Heights, not its own plan area.
It sits in Rosemary Heights, south of the Nicomekl River, east of Highway 99, northeast of 160 Street and 32 Avenue.

blocks.text: Morgan Creek Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Houses are single-family dwellings around the course, at 2 units per acre gross including course lands.
The course is Morgan Creek Golf Course, 3500 Morgan Creek Way, 18 holes, public year-round.

blocks.text: Morgan Creek Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Development is OCP-led: the three Rosemary Heights plans were rescinded under the Surrey 2050 OCP update.
Course lands carry Comprehensive Development zoning (Bylaw Nos. 12961, 13973): "Golf Course and Clustering at Single Family Density."

blocks.text: Morgan Creek home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

45 houses sold in Morgan Creek with a median price of $1,960,000 (the middle half sold between $1,675,000 and $2,270,000), taking a median of 30 days to sell at 94.9% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $489 per square foot, a median year built of 2003 and a median lot of 7,137 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 45 houses listed in Morgan Creek. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Morgan Creek a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Morgan Creek had a sales ratio of 2%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Morgan Creek from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 16 houses sold in Morgan Creek over those 5 months, out of 294 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Which elementary schools serve Morgan Creek?
faq.a: Rosemary Heights and Morgan elementary schools serve this area, per the City, at 15516 36 Avenue and 3366 156A Street respectively.

faq.q: Which secondary school do students attend?
faq.a: Grandview Heights Secondary, on the district's own letter: its December 4, 2020 letter lists Morgan and Rosemary Heights among the feeder elementary schools making up the catchment for the secondary school at 16987 25 Avenue. (check current — letter dated 2020)

faq.q: Is the golf course private for residents?
faq.a: No — it is a public course. Morgan Creek Golf Course describes itself as open to the public year-round at 3500 Morgan Creek Way, so non-residents play the same fairways that residents back onto, and living beside it is not required to play.

faq.q: How do I confirm a catchment?
faq.a: Use the district School Locator tool. Surrey Schools states your catchment school is determined by your address and where it falls within the district's School Boundaries Map, and directs families to input the address into the Locator on its registration page.

faq.q: What did houses in Morgan Creek sell for?
faq.a: 45 houses sold in Morgan Creek between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,960,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: The median was 30 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.9% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
